sections.title: Warm-up
sections.prompt: State an opinion you hold, then give the strongest objection to it.
items: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen, …
sections.lede: Say each line aloud once. This section is not scored.

sections.title: Learning objectives
sections.lede: These are the three things you will be able to do by the end of the lesson.

sections.title: The big picture
sections.lede: Sophisticated argumentation concedes what is true, qualifies what is uncertain and refutes what is wrong.

blocks.text: A concession shows that you understand the other side: “Zwar trifft es zu, dass … jedoch …”. This does not weaken your position; it makes your disagreement more credible because you have engaged with the strongest version of the opposing view.

Qualify claims with adverbs and modal verbs: “tendenziell”, “in der Regel”, “dürfte”, “lässt sich vermuten”. Precision about uncertainty is a sign of expertise, not weakness. Refute an argument by naming the specific premise or evidence you reject.

blocks.title: Concede, qualify, refute
blocks.text: Use this three-step pattern in discussions. It keeps the exchange constructive and makes your objection harder to dismiss.

sections.title: Rules & patterns
sections.lede: The patterns to keep in mind while you work through the examples.

rows: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen, …
Das dürfte in der Regel der Fall sein.
Der Einwand greift zu kurz, weil …
Hier muss man zwischen … und … differenzieren.

items: “Zwar … jedoch” is a fixed contrast pair across two clauses.
“Insofern” means “in that respect” and often introduces a qualification.
“Einwenden” is the verb for raising an objection: Ich möchte einwenden, dass …

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.lede: Listen once, then read the example aloud.

items.example: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen, wer die Kosten trägt.
items.exampleEn: Admittedly that is true, however the question of who bears the costs remains open.

items.example: Insofern ist der Vorschlag sinnvoll, als er Kosten spart.
items.exampleEn: In that respect the proposal makes sense insofar as it saves costs.

items.example: Man muss zwischen kurz- und langfristigen Folgen differenzieren.
items.exampleEn: One must differentiate between short- and long-term consequences.

items.example: Ich möchte einwenden, dass die Daten veraltet sind.
items.exampleEn: I would like to object that the data are outdated.

sections.title: Example sentences
sections.lede: Notice how the pattern behaves in a complete sentence.

items.de: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen, wer die Kosten trägt.
items.en: Admittedly that is true, however the question of who bears the costs remains open.

items.de: Das dürfte in der Regel der Fall sein.
items.en: That is likely to be the case as a rule.

items.de: Der Einwand greift zu kurz, weil er die langfristigen Kosten ignoriert.
items.en: The objection falls short because it ignores long-term costs.
items.note: A precise refutation names what is missing.

items.de: Man muss zwischen kurzfristigen und langfristigen Folgen differenzieren.
items.en: One must differentiate between short-term and long-term consequences.

sections.title: Pronunciation
sections.lede: Short, focused sound work. Play each item and repeat it twice.

items.hint: The z is a ts sound: tsvahr.

blocks.text: German academic debate can be direct, but it is expected to be argument-based. “Das überzeugt mich nicht, weil …” is normal; personal attacks are not.
Concessions are common in serious writing. A text that ignores the strongest counterargument is seen as less credible, not more decisive.

sections.title: Dialogue in context
sections.lede: Read the scene, then play it and follow the speakers.
sections.setting: A panel discussion about a four-day week.

lines.speaker: Moderatorin
lines.de: Spricht die Vier-Tage-Woche für mehr Produktivität?
lines.en: Does the four-day week lead to higher productivity?

lines.speaker: Experte
lines.de: Zwar trifft es zu, dass erste Studien positiv sind, jedoch ist die Datenlage begrenzt.
lines.en: Admittedly it is true that initial studies are positive, however the evidence base is limited.

lines.speaker: Expertin
lines.de: Insofern stimme ich zu, als wir zwischen Branchen differenzieren müssen.
lines.en: In that respect I agree, insofar as we have to differentiate between sectors.

lines.speaker: Experte
lines.de: Der Einwand ist berechtigt. Dennoch dürfte die Richtung stimmen.
lines.en: The objection is justified. Nevertheless, the direction is likely to be right.

sections.title: Grammar spotlight
sections.heading: Concession and qualification
sections.lede: Use two-part structures to show both sides without losing your position.

rows: Der Einwand greift zu kurz, weil …

blocks.text: “Zwar” introduces the concession and “jedoch” the main point. The verb follows the normal rules in each clause; jedoch does not change the word order by itself.

sections.tip: Before you disagree, say what is right in the other view. It makes your objection harder to ignore.

sections.title: Choose the right answer

exercises.prompt: Build: “Admittedly that is true, however the question remains open.”

exercises.explanation: Both clauses keep the verb in second position.

exercises.answer: Der Einwand greift zu kurz, weil er die Kosten ignoriert.
exercises.explanation: The weil-clause ends with the verb ignoriert.

exercises.explanation: The modal muss sends the infinitive to the end.

sections.title: Speaking
sections.lede: Record or say your answer aloud, then compare it with the model.
sections.prompt: Take a position on a current debate, concede one valid point and refute one objection.

model.de: Zwar trifft es zu, dass die Maßnahme Kosten verursacht, jedoch dürfte sie langfristig mehr sparen. Der Einwand, sie sei nicht umsetzbar, greift zu kurz, weil viele Kommunen bereits ähnliche Projekte durchführen.
model.en: Admittedly it is true that the measure causes costs, however it is likely to save more in the long term. The objection that it is not feasible falls short because many municipalities already run similar projects.

tips: Start with a concession, not with your objection.
Use dürfte or tendenziell to qualify your claim.
Name the specific weakness in the opposing argument.

sections.title: Common mistakes
sections.lede: These are the errors learners most often make with this pattern.

items.wrong: Zwar trifft das zu, aber jedoch bleibt die Frage offen.
items.right: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen.
items.why: Use either aber or jedoch, not both.
The fixed expression is zu kurz greifen.

items.wrong: Man muss zwischen A und B differenzieren machen.
items.right: Man muss zwischen A und B differenzieren.
items.why: Differenzieren is already the verb; do not add machen.
